title: A Central Limit Theorem for Regularized M-Estimators
summary: We prove a quantitative central limit theorem for linear functionals of regularized empirical-risk minimizers in the proportional-dimensional regime \(p=O(n)\). The data columns are independent, not necessarily identically distributed, and satisfy a uniform columnwise Poincaré inequality.
